narrative:
Defiance County has 25,892 registered voters, with 14.6% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 31.1% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 49.6%, a pronounced Democratic lean of 18.5 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.1% of registrants.
